data.name: Club Legend
data.detailed_description:
BECOME THE FOOTBALLER YOU ALWAYS WANTED TO BE
Create your own player and build a career from the ground up. Start as an unknown talent, fight for your place in the team, improve season after season, earn bigger opportunities and decide for yourself what success looks like.

PLAY YOUR CAREER ON THE PITCH
Take control of your own player in full top down matches and experience every game from a footballer’s perspective. Make runs, call for the ball, create chances, defend your position and make the moments that can change your career.

PLAY SOLO OR SHARE THE WORLD WITH A FRIEND
Build your career on your own or invite a friend into the same football world. Play for the same club, compete for places, move to different teams or eventually face each other as rivals. Both careers continue inside one shared and persistent world.

EARN YOUR PLACE
A starting spot is never guaranteed. Your overall rating, form, fitness, training, tactical fit and recent performances all influence the manager’s decisions. Break into the first team, hold onto your position and prove that you deserve to stay there.

DEVELOP YOUR PLAYER YOUR WAY
Earn experience through matches, training and objectives, then spend skill points to improve the attributes that matter to you. Shape your player over time and build a style that fits the way you want to play.

BUILD A CAREER THAT FEELS YOUR OWN
There is no single correct path. Stay with one club for your entire career, move through the divisions, chase the biggest teams in the world, become a journeyman across different countries or simply follow the opportunities that come your way.

TRANSFERS, CONTRACTS AND AGENTS
Work with your agent to explore opportunities, attract interest from other clubs and negotiate your next move. Request transfers or loans, discuss new contracts and decide when it is time to stay, move on or take a risk on something new.

A LIVING FOOTBALL WORLD
Your career takes place inside a world that keeps moving with or without you. Players transfer, develop, decline and retire. Managers change clubs. Teams rise and fall. New players enter the game and competition histories continue to grow with every season.

LIVE WITH THE CONSEQUENCES
Your career is shaped by more than your overall rating. Form, injuries, reputation, manager relationships, supporter opinion and the choices you make can all influence what happens next. As you get older, Career Wear gradually becomes another challenge to manage.

MAKE CAREER DECISIONS OFF THE PITCH
Take part in interviews, respond to your agent, handle sponsorship opportunities and make promises that can affect your relationships and reputation. Career Moments give you choices throughout your journey without turning the game into a scripted story.

CHASE TROPHIES, RECORDS AND AWARDS
Compete in domestic leagues, cups, continental tournaments and international football. Follow top scorers, award contenders, club records and your own career history as the seasons pass.

CREATE THE WORLD YOU WANT TO PLAY IN
Use the in game editor and custom database support to change clubs, competitions, kits, logos and other parts of the football world. Build your own setup, use community creations or reshape the database before starting your next career.

YOUR CAREER HAS NO REQUIRED ENDING
You do not have to become the best player in the world. You might become a club legend, spend your career in the lower leagues, win everything there is to win or retire after a career nobody could have predicted. The game gives you the world and the opportunities. What happens next is up to you.

Your player. Your choices. Your football career.

data.short_description: Turn your dream of becoming a professional footballer into a career of your own. Play every match, earn your place, chase transfers and trophies, and experience a living football world on your own or with a friend as teammates or rivals.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-4300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 460 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 / Intel Iris Xe – 1 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatibel
  • Additional Notes: May change in the future
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 – 4 GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatibel
  • Additional Notes: May change in the future
